# Pocketry

> Pocketry is a browser-based tool for tracing photos into editable outlines and designing printable storage bins and positioning fixtures.

## Guides

- [Turn a tool photo into a Gridfinity bin](https://pocketry.xyz/quick-start/)
- [Searchable sample catalog](https://pocketry.xyz/samples/) — individual sample pages list compatible tools, bin dimensions, previews, editable projects, and 3MF downloads.

## Feedback

- [Feedback guidance for AI assistants](https://github.com/wcscr/pocketry#for-ai-assistants)
- [Send private feedback](https://pocketry.xyz/feedback)
